TITLE: Reports
subtitle: Results of compliance analyses: applicable acts, findings and action plans.
emptyText: Pick a company and run a compliance analysis.
loadError: The reports could not be loaded

START.title: Compliance analysis
START.note: The analysis takes a few minutes: it determines the applicable acts, assesses every obligation against the company's evidence and drafts an action plan.
START.unattended: Continue without waiting for the list of acts to be approved
START.unattendedHint: Unticked, the analysis stops once it has decided which legal acts apply and waits for you to approve the list. The obligations are judged only after that.
START.internal: Also assess the company's own requirements
START.internalHint: Checks whether the procedures carry out what the company's own policies require; these findings are counted apart.
START.internalNone: The company has no policy-level documents.
START.scopeHint: Empty — the analysis picks the applicable acts itself.
START.estimateExtraction: Of which ~{extraction} is shared corpus work (obligations extracted for the first time: {acts}); it is paid from the shared budget, not your daily budget.
START.estimateInternal: Of which ~{usd} is the assessment of the company's own requirements (policy-level documents: {documents}, requirements: ~{requirements}).
START.estimateUnknown: The cost could not be estimated — the model prices are unknown.
START.estimateFloor: At least {total} ({acts} legal acts, ~{obligations} obligations) — without the models whose price is unknown.
START.budgetUnlimited: Your daily AI budget is unlimited.
START.overBudget: The estimate exceeds your remaining daily budget. A started analysis is not stopped, so today's spending may go over it.
START.estimateFailed: The cost estimate could not be loaded
START.companiesFailed: The companies could not be loaded
START.actsFailed: The legal acts could not be loaded
